notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.4.2
notes.content:
In preparation for the tournament, a huge number of bug fixes has been the focus of the development. This version will fix majority of the bugs, and make Multiplayer more stable than ever before.

Bug fixes:

 Fixed a bug where the ball doesn't despawn on Multiplayer beach map
 Fixed a bug where the point is wrongly given when the ball hits the roof
 Fixed a bug where there are no in/out indicators in sandbox maps
 Fixed a bug where aces dont count in sp
 Fixed a bug where the ball touches the antenna when it didn't in Multiplayer
 Fixed a bug where the fouls UI doesn't disappear
 Fixed a bug where blocks dont register sometimes
 Fixed a bug where cancelling a jump results in a double approach animation
 Removed ghost touches on the blocks and on players


New changes:

 Improved bot's capability to cover after being blocked
 Improved rollback system
 Added scoreboard system to Multiplayer
 Added a ping indicator
 Added ball velocity in Multiplayer matches

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.4.1
notes.content:
New Features:
Client/Server rollback system makes defense and setting more stable when in a Multiplayer match!
Player stat preset function to save and load different presets!
New Mik*sa inspired Volleyball skin for all games!

Bug fixes (SUPER BIG FIXES):
Blocks sometimes not registering – fixed an issue where some block touches were not being counted.
No-touch aces not counted – fixed scoring so aces still award points even without a registered touch.
Point awarding issues – resolved most incorrect point award scenarios.
Serve mode switching exploit – fixed a bug where players could switch out of serve mode while still holding the ball.
Multiplayer bot blocking – fixed a bug where bots would not jump to block attacks from non-host players.
Jump setting inaccuracy – fixed an issue where jump sets would be inaccurate even when jumping straight up.
Lobby hosting failures – fixed multiple issues causing lobby creation to fail.
Bot movement after points – bots now teleport to their correct serve/receive positions at the start of each point to prevent them from getting stuck.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.2.2
notes.content:
We're back with a small update before we start working on the next big change!

🏐 Fixes & Improvements:

🛠 Fixed Kill Block Scoring Bug – Points from kill blocks are now correctly awarded to the blocking player’s team.
🎯 Improved Referee Accuracy – Referees now make more precise calls for in/out and faults.
⚙️ Settings Now Work While Holding – Adjusting settings mid-hold now applies correctly.
🤷‍♂️ Fixed Set Call Bug – Calling for a set no longer causes serves and spikes to be redirected at you.
🏗 Sandbox Collision Fixes – Resolved jump-related collision issues when using low player height.
🎾 Fixed Serving Bot in Sandbox – The bot now correctly serves without errors.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
We're back with the biggest update and overhaul to the game!

Improved AI

 Middle Blocker now adjusts and follows the pin blocker so the player can choose to block line or cross.
 Spiking accuracy improved and backrow hits are now more consistent
 You can now call a set from the AI using the button "E" 


Added Functionalities

 You can now change your hitting arm to left handed in preferences
 New resolutions added (UHD and 4K)
 You can now emote by holding "T"


Achievements

 There are now achievements to be farmed and collected in the game! (Only works in sandbox and singleplayer for now)


Multiplayer Changes

 You can now host a multiplayer game and invite friends through steam to get past the region-lock of the lobby code system!
 There is now an option to host a 6v6 game with bots in Multiplayer by pressing escape and pressing "Team" to join in a certain position.


Bug fixes

 Multiplayer now has player customization fully working, both on stats and on looks.
 Receiving is now working perfectly in Multiplayer.

notes.title: Update Notes for v1.1.8
notes.content:
Singleplayer Overhaul Update

The Singleplayer experience is receiving a complete overhaul update!

Below are the changes and additions to the Singleplayer mode:


 AI Spikers will now have new spiking options.
 AI Spikers will have the intelligence to attempt to avoid blockers, based on the difficulty of the AI.
 AI Blockers will randomly pick between three blocking patterns (Block line, Block cross, Leave seam)
 Names added to AI player characters
 There is now a scoreboard for tracking individual player stats by pressing tab! This tracks: Kills, Blocks, Assists, Digs and Aces.

We hope you enjoy this big update that we have been hard at work for, and see you guys soon for more changes and improvements focused on Multiplayer!

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.1.6
notes.content:
Pretty big changes this patch!

IMPORTANT
RESET YOUR STATS IN PLAYER CUSTOMIZATION TO FIX ANY BUGS WITH NO MOVEMENT

Stamina System
We're adding a brand new system into the game! Along with new stats to allocate your points into! Stamina will affect jump height and movement speed. This adds a new level of difficulty that forces players to be more careful about their decisions ingame.

Stamina Costing Actions
Sprinting, diving and jumping all consumes stamina.

Regenerating Stamina
Standing completely still will regenerate your stamina at max speed, while moving and crouching will half the regeneration rate. 

Tutorial Mode
We also implemented a way better tutorial mode for new players to figure out all the mechanics and basic controls hands on rather than reading from pages. It can be accessed from the "Tutorial" button in the main menu.

AI Improvements
The AI will no longer go for balls that are served out, or tooled by teammates.

New Sandbox Practice Tools
We also added two new tools for players to practice in the sandbox mode! This can be accessed under a new tab in sandbox mode setting called "PRACTICE". The two practice tools are targets for setting, and also targets for spiking/serving.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
New Features
Reworked Setting Mechanic
Due to the difficulty of the previous setting system and how precise the timing was needed for a good set, setting now works by detecting the ball reaching into your hands after you release and automatically setting when it reaches in range. Moving while setting will also result in a less accurate set to compensate for the lower skill ceiling.

Added New Stats

 Receiving now has a stat for how accurate the receive is to target, even if you are off the center-line
 Spin proficiency added to the game, which affects how much spin you can apply onto the ball.

Added New UI For Spike Timing
A new HUD is added on the top left that tells you how good your timing was on the spike release, as well as where you contacted the ball. These factors accurately affects how much power is generated.


Bug Fixes and QOL Changes
[olist]
 Receiving animations smoothened
 Receiving hitbox adjusted for better gameplay
 Spike hitbox adjusted for better reflection on where your shoulder is
 Transition time between receiving states reduced for smoother gameplay
 Animation no longer bugs when crouching mid set/spike
 Visibility of setting improved, animations adjusted
[/olist]
